description: Guided Acoustic Wave Dataset for Railway Track Defect Detection Using Piezoelectric Sensors is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Hariram V, Dr. Hemalatha K. "This dataset contains acoustic guided wave signals acquired from a laboratory-scale railway track prototype instrumented with piezoelectric transducers for structural health monitoring and crack detection applications. The dataset comprises 2,000 time-series samples, including 1,000 defectless and 1,000 defective rail conditions generated through controlled experiments. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
